extras: Security Note: If a GitHub API token is used, it is stored in the Obsidian config and carries risks if the vault or config files are shared.
intentEvidence: This Obsidian plugin imports your starred GitHub repositories into your Obsidian vault as notes with rich metadata.
problem: Users need a way to track and document interesting external projects from GitHub directly within their Obsidian vault.
summary: GitHub Integration imports starred repositories from GitHub into Obsidian notes, creating structured notes with rich metadata and allowing incremental updates.
